iboxs31_led_init.tooltip: The four onboard WS2812 LEDs are on IO38 (the default); for an external strip, set its pin and count. All LEDs go off first and auto refresh is turned on

iboxs31_led_brightness.tooltip: Overall brightness 0–255 (255 by default, very bright; a few tens is enough); it only scales the output and keeps the colours you set

iboxs31_led_set_pixel.tooltip: Sets one LED to a colour; numbering starts at 1

iboxs31_led_set_range.tooltip: Sets a run of LEDs to one colour; numbering starts at 1 and both ends are included

iboxs31_led_fill.tooltip: Sets every LED to one colour

iboxs31_led_bar.message0: LEDs bar LEDs %1 to %2 light %3 foreground %4 background %5
iboxs31_led_bar.tooltip: Uses a run of LEDs as a bar: that many from the start get the foreground colour, the rest the background; if the end is below the start it fills backwards

iboxs31_led_rainbow.tooltip: Hue 0–255 is one full turn (0 red, 85 green, 170 blue); add a little to the start hue each time to make it move

iboxs31_led_effect.tooltip: Keep it in the loop: each call draws the next frame from the time and never blocks; speed 1–10, higher is faster; rainbow flow ignores the colour

iboxs31_led_auto_show.tooltip: On (the default after init) shows every colour change at once; off lets you set all colours first and show them together with the refresh block, faster and tidier for long strips

iboxs31_led_show.tooltip: Sends the colours you set to the LEDs; only needed while auto refresh is off

iboxs31_led_count.tooltip: The LED count set at init; 0 if init failed

iboxs31_led_color.tooltip: Pick a colour with the colour picker

iboxs31_led_rgb.tooltip: Mixes a colour from red, green and blue, each 0–255

iboxs31_led_hsv.tooltip: All three are 0–255: hue is one turn (0 red, 85 green, 170 blue), saturation 0 is white, value 0 is black
